name: Almost Heaven Huntington 4-6 Person Canopy Barrel Sauna, 6x7+1 ft. – 1 ft. Porch
description: Almost Heaven Huntington 4-6 Person Barrel Sauna The Huntington 6-Person Canopy Barrel Sauna offers a well-rounded traditional sauna experience: plenty of room to stretch out and enjoy the sauna heat, plus two exterior benches to cool off. Due to the canopy design, seven feet of the 8-foot-long outdoor sauna are reserved for the sauna room, while the exterior benches take up the remaining foot. The Huntington's barrel sauna space has room for up to 6 people to enjoy temperatures of 180ºF and beyond. The included Harvia KIP80B 8 kW electric heater can start right away, or you can delay the start time up to eight hours—go about your day or go to sleep, and the Huntington Barrel Sauna will be hot when you are ready to get in! Features Ball-and-socket lumber: 1-3/8″ thick Any glass features are tempered Stainless steel bands, hinges, heater and fasteners Interior LED light Sauna stones included Weather-resistant plastic support cradles Two opposite-facing benches for sitting or reclining Two exterior opposite-facing benches Indoor or outdoor usage Hand-crafted lumber profiles and end sections Best-in-class electric heater and sauna stones Limited lifetime warranty on the sauna room; 5-year limited lifetime warranty on the heater and its components, with a 1-year warranty on the heating elements (coils) Made in the USA Specifications Capacity: holds between four and six people Standard heater (Harvia KIP80B): 8 kW, 240V, 40-amp electrical requirement, hardwire connect Lighting electrical: 110V, 15-amp service, plug-in connect Assembled size: 72″W x 95″D x 77″H Interior room size: 71″W x 75″D x 71″H Interior bench dimensions: 18″W x 75″L x 17″H Canopy porch size: 71″W x 12″D x 71″H Exterior bench dimensions: 18″W x 12″L x 25″H Cradle dimensions 54" x 6" Shipping weight: 915 lbs Shipping size: 96″L x 41″W x 52″H Note: All dimensions are approximate Options and Customizations Vista or Port rear window: Open the Salem barrel sauna interior to breathtaking views with the addition of the Vista or Port rear window. Door style: Outfit your 6-person canopy barrel sauna with one of the following deluxe door options: full glass door, wood door with a window, or all-wood door.  Stains: Choose from our range of exterior sauna stains , available in Natural, Walnut, Larch, and Teak shades, to perfectly complement your selected lumber type, such as a Larch cedar swatch. Heater: The Almost Heaven Huntington 6-person barrel sauna can be paired with an electric heater. See product options for all available heaters. Care and Maintenance Traditional saunas require very little upkeep. Simply wipe down the interior after each use and check for any dust or debris that you may have tracked in. Shipping and Assembly The Huntington will ship via an LTL truck and will arrive curbside. Some basic handyman skills are helpful when assembling the 6-person barrel sauna. The only additional equipment needed is a cordless drill. Two people can generally do the assembly in 6 hours or less. It is recommended that you review the assembly manual in advance to familiarize yourself with the process. Two Ways to Enjoy Your Sauna Heater and stones are essential to a traditional sauna experience. With the room at least heated to 160ºF, the traditional sauna can be enjoyed in two ways. The first is called a dry sauna, which lacks any added moisture. The second is called a wet sauna, where you sprinkle water onto the heated stones to create a refreshing burst of steam and added humidity. Why Select Saunas? Every sauna in our collection is backed by the original manufacturer's warranty, assuring the highest standards of quality and performance. Plus, enjoy hassle-free returns, a no-questions-asked satisfaction guarantee, and complimentary gifts with your order. Visit Select Saunas today to find the perfect sauna for your space and lifestyle! Resources Almost Heaven Barrel Sauna Installation & Owner’s Manual Videos
